org_name.title: Org Name
org_name.description: A human friendly name of the organization.

default_user_preferences.description:
Default user preferences for new users in this organization. This field is only populated if this endpoint is called with user authentication credentials,
and the authenticated user has the `Organization:GetOrganizationDetails` permission.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: The tenant ID of the organization. This field is only populated if the authenticated user has the `Organization:GetOrganizationDetails` permission.

enable_response_recommendation.title: Enable Response Recommendation
enable_response_recommendation.description: Whether to automatically recommend responses to the user if the user hasn't replied to the coach for a while.

preferred_language.title: Preferred Language
preferred_language.description:
The preferred language to use for the user. This field must be in the ISO 639-3 format. The agent will attempt to converse
with the user in this language. If not set, the agent's default spoken language is used.

conversations_visible_to_admins.title: Conversations Visible To Admins
conversations_visible_to_admins.description: Whether the user's conversations are visible to the admins.

user_model_visible_to_admins.title: User Model Visible To Admins
user_model_visible_to_admins.description: Whether the user's user model is visible to the admins.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The user's timezone in the IANA tz database format for all users in this organization. If not specified, UTC is used.

audio_keyterms.title: Audio Keyterms
audio_keyterms.description: A list of keyterms that are easy to get wrong during audio transcriptions that tend to occur commonly in audio sessions for this user.

Preferences-Output.title: Preferences
Preferences-Output.description: Preferences that the user can set to customize their experience.
